# f5xc_known_label_key (Resource)

Get Label Key Request Get Label Key Request is used in following way namespace = shared if query = QUERY_ALL_LABEL_KEYS then key is ignored and complete list of label keys from current tenant's shared namespace and ves-io/shared namespace are returned if query = QUERY_EXACT_LABEL_KEY then label key matching exact key is returned from list of labels in current tenants shared namespace and ves-io/shared namespace if query = QUERY_PREFIX_LABEL_KEYS then label keys matching key are returned from list of labels in current tenants shared namespace and ves-io shared namespace are returned

To get more information about f5xc_known_label_key, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/known-label-key)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Known Label Key - Description

resource "f5xc_known_label_key" "example" {
  key         = "example-klk"
  namespace   = "shared"
  description = "Known label key example"
}
```
